identificationModule.officialTitle: A Safety and Efficacy Study of CD19-UCART (Allogeneic Engineered T-cells Expressing Anti-CD19 Chimeric Antigen Receptor) in Patients With Relapsed or Refractory B-cell Hematologic Malignancies

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: CD19-UCART is a kind of "off-the-shelf" product originated from health donor's PBMC.This is a open-label, dose estilation study to evaluate the safety and anti-tumor efficacy of CD19-UCART in the treatment of relapsed or refractory B-cell hematological malignancies.

primaryOutcomes.description: Adverse events assessed according to NCI-CTCAE v5.0 criteria
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline up to 35 days after T cell infusion

secondaryOutcomes.description: The total response rate after 90 days of treatment with study drug (overall response rate for ALL= CR+CRi; for NHL=CR+PR);
The 90-day progression-free survival rate following drug therapy.

otherOutcomes.description: The number of UCART cells surviving in the body within 90 days after receiving the study drug;
The time from treatment with study drug to tumor progression or death.
the time from treatment with study drug to death by any cause.
